x: Pfenninger, Finneron, Melchior and Sutton have done much to help our Field Events along, and Vallance may become a first-class pole vaulter in due course.
Pfenninger won the Weight Putt for us with a magnificent effort of 39ft. 6in., and also took second place in the Discus Throw (116ft. 5½in.) and fourth in the High Jump (5ft. 6in.).
Heider promises to succeed Pfenninger in versatility, for he has cleared 5 ft. 9 ins.
Jones had an excellent win in the Shot Putt with 39ft. 1in.—the best performance yet in Club events by "home" talent—only Grassau and Pfenninger having beaten it.
